extraction.Name: Philomena Beauvais Leighton
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged it and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: They charged me $50 for coming from Carter and making the mortgage.
extraction.Occupation/Income: We farm and sell cream and so forth.
extraction.NOTES: Did not sign receipt for patent; application found in allotment folder — 'It looks something like my handwriting but I do not remember signing it'; another application signed before H.
